_fabricated: This is a fabricated example for illustration purposes. No real targets, vulnerabilities, or program data is included.

vectors.vector: Race condition in coupon redemption — fire N concurrent redeem requests for a single-use promo code to see if more than one succeeds
vectors.detail: 20 concurrent POST /api/v1/promos/redeem requests against a fresh single-use code; exactly 1 succeeded (HTTP 200), 19 received HTTP 409 'already redeemed'. DB-level unique constraint with row locking confirmed, no TOCTOU window observed across 5 repeated runs.

vectors.vector: GraphQL alias batching to bypass per-request rate limiting on the search endpoint
vectors.detail: Batched 100 aliased `search(query:)` calls into a single POST. WAF returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge page at >15 aliases per request, before the application-layer rate limiter was ever reached. Could not determine whether app-layer protection exists behind the WAF.

vectors.vector: OAuth `state` parameter fixation — reuse a captured state value across sessions to attempt CSRF on the OAuth callback
vectors.detail: Captured state token from session 1, replayed it as the state param in session 2's authorization request. Callback handler validates state against a server-side session-bound value (not just presence), so the replayed value was rejected with HTTP 400 'invalid_state'. No CSRF window found.
